description: Design and build server-side applications and APIs. Work with databases, authentication, and business logic. Common stack: Python or Java, Django/Flask/FastAPI or Spring Boot, PostgreSQL/MySQL, REST APIs, Docker.
Build user interfaces and client-side applications. Work with React, Angular, or Vue, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and responsive design. Focus on UX and browser performance.
Build both client and server sides of web applications. Comfortable with a frontend framework, a backend framework, and a database, deploying end-to-end features.

Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and systems. Work with programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript, software architecture, databases, APIs, testing, version control, and development methodologies.
Build and deploy machine learning models. Work with Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, scikit-learn, data pipelines, model evaluation, and production ML serving with ONNX or similar.
Analyze data to extract insights and build predictive models. Work with Python or R, pandas, statistical analysis, data visualization, and machine learning.

Design and develop artificial intelligence solutions for real-world applications. Work with machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, generative AI, model APIs, Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, and AI application frameworks.
Build natural language processing and conversational AI systems. Work with spaCy, Hugging Face transformers, LangChain, vector databases, and LLM-based applications.
Develop systems that analyze and interpret images and video. Work with OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow, CNNs, object detection, image classification, segmentation, OCR, and computer vision pipelines.

Build and maintain infrastructure for deploying and managing machine learning systems. Work with ML pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated model deployment.
Build data pipelines and infrastructure for large-scale data processing. Work with Spark, Airflow, SQL, data warehousing, and ETL systems.
Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights. Work with SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI or Tableau, statistical analysis, data visualization, and reporting.
Automate infrastructure and deployment pipelines. Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, AWS/Azure/GCP, monitoring and reliability.

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud-based infrastructure and applications. Work with AWS, Azure, or GCP, networking, virtual machines, containers, storage, databases, security, automation, and infrastructure as code.

Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of software systems. Work with cloud infrastructure, monitoring, observability, automation, incident management, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and system scalability.

Design and implement security solutions to protect applications, networks, and systems. Work with network security, vulnerability assessment, encryption, authentication, firewalls, security monitoring, penetration testing, and incident response.

Design, configure, and maintain computer networks and communication infrastructure. Work with TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, network monitoring, and technologies from vendors such as Cisco and Juniper.

Design, develop, optimize, and maintain database systems. Work with SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, database architecture, indexing, query optimization, transactions, replication, backups, and database security.
Build native or cross-platform mobile applications. Work with Swift, Kotlin, React Native, or Flutter, and mobile UI/UX patterns.

Design and develop software for embedded devices and microcontrollers. Work with C or C++, microcontrollers, sensors, communication protocols, RTOS, hardware interfaces, debugging, and real-time systems.

Develop low-level software that controls electronic hardware and embedded devices. Work with C or C++, microcontrollers, device drivers, memory management, communication protocols, hardware debugging, and real-time operating systems.

Design and develop robotic systems that interact with physical environments. Work with robotics software, sensors, actuators, computer vision, control systems, ROS, Python, C++, and autonomous navigation.

Design and integrate complex software, hardware, and infrastructure systems. Work with system architecture, requirements analysis, networking, operating systems, performance optimization, reliability, and system integration.

Protect cloud infrastructure, applications, and data from security threats. Work with AWS, Azure, or GCP security services, IAM, encryption, network security, vulnerability management, compliance, and security monitoring.

Develop decentralized applications and blockchain-based systems. Work with blockchain platforms, smart contracts, Solidity, Web3 technologies, cryptography, wallets, decentralized storage, and blockchain APIs.

Design and develop interactive games for desktop, mobile, or console platforms. Work with Unity or Unreal Engine, C# or C++, game physics, graphics, gameplay systems, animation, and performance optimization.
Design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and ensure software quality. Work with Selenium, Postman, CI pipelines, and bug tracking.

Develop automated solutions for software testing, infrastructure, and business processes. Work with Python, Java, Selenium, APIs, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, workflow automation, and monitoring systems.

Build internal platforms and infrastructure that enable development teams to deploy and operate applications efficiently. Work with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automation, and developer tooling.

Design scalable technical solutions that meet business and application requirements. Work with cloud architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, security, networking, system integration, and technologies across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Analyze and optimize the performance, scalability, and resource efficiency of software systems. Work with profiling tools, benchmarking, load testing, system optimization, databases, distributed systems, and performance monitoring.

Develop and implement experimental algorithms and technologies to solve complex engineering problems. Work with research methodologies, prototyping, machine learning, algorithms, data analysis, scientific computing, and emerging technologies.
